nodes.label: Pieces Not Screens Philosophy
nodes.author: bidah
nodes.rationale: Each beat shows a cropped UI component, not a full screenshot. The viewer sees the feature in action, not a screen tour. This isolates the meaningful interaction and avoids visual overload.

nodes.label: SKILL.md Skill Definition Format
nodes.author: bidah
nodes.rationale: Detailed operating rules, workflow steps, and forbidden patterns in a single markdown file make an excellent template for writing Claude Code skills.

nodes.label: Intake-First Workflow
nodes.author: bidah
nodes.rationale: Won't start rendering until it has stills + intent for every screen. Ensures completeness before execution.

nodes.label: Screenshots to Animated Onboarding Video LinkedIn Post
nodes.norm_label: screenshots to animated onboarding video linkedin post

nodes.label: Claude Code Skills as Distribution Channel
nodes.rationale: Claude Code skills are becoming a distribution channel: creators build, curators share, non-technical users adopt. The 'install in 60 seconds' framing removes friction.
nodes.norm_label: claude code skills as distribution channel

nodes.label: Claude Code Guide by Ruben Hassid
nodes.author: Ruben Hassid
nodes.norm_label: claude code guide by ruben hassid

nodes.label: Screenshot-Based Prompting
nodes.author: Ruben Hassid
nodes.rationale: Paste images of desired designs and Claude recreates them. The most powerful technique for non-coders: show, don't describe.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md Memory File
nodes.author: Ruben Hassid
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md is the key persistence mechanism across sessions. Create project documentation so Claude remembers design choices.

nodes.label: My Claude Code Can INSTANTLY Watch Any Video
nodes.author: Brad | AI & Automation
nodes.norm_label: my claude code can instantly watch any video

nodes.label: Frames + Transcript Decomposition
nodes.author: Brad | AI & Automation
nodes.rationale: Since Anthropic has no native video model, decompose video into frames + transcript — two modalities Claude already understands. Half of interesting stuff in video isn't said out loud, it happens on screen, so transcript-only tools miss critical context.

nodes.label: MIT + Enterprise Dual License Model
nodes.author: OpenHands (fork by shekerkamma)
nodes.rationale: Core is fully open-source MIT while enterprise directory has separate commercial license. Great template for open-source commercialization - keeps core accessible while monetizing enterprise features.

nodes.label: Product Ladder Strategy
nodes.author: OpenHands (fork by shekerkamma)
nodes.rationale: SDK -> CLI -> GUI -> Cloud -> Enterprise, each step adds value. Modular product surface where all surfaces share the same core engine.

nodes.label: LLM-Agnostic Design
nodes.author: OpenHands (fork by shekerkamma)
nodes.rationale: Works with Claude, GPT, or any LLM - not locked to one provider. Avoids vendor lock-in and broadens market.
